name: Leiden University Research Integrity Committee
mandate: Leiden University Research Integrity Committee investigates suspected breaches of the Netherlands Code of Conduct for Research Integrity (2018) committed under the responsibility of Leiden University. The committee operates under the Leiden University Regulations on Complaints Regarding Academic Integrity and advises the board on findings and systemic improvements.

reporting_channels.description: Academic integrity overview with committee contacts and training obligations.

composition.chair: Independent full professor appointed by Leiden University's Executive Board for a renewable four-year term.
members: Three to five senior academics from different faculties with no conflict of interest.
A legal/ethics secretary from the integrity or governance office.
external_members: At least one professor from another Dutch knowledge institution.
External legal or ethics expert assigned per case.

process.intake: Confidential advisers and integrity coordinators at Leiden University support staff or students when drafting a signed complaint; the Executive Board forwards admissible cases to the committee.
process.investigation: Leiden University Research Integrity Committee screens admissibility, appoints rapporteurs, collects documentation, and interviews the complainant, respondent, and witnesses with written minutes.
process.outcome: A reasoned opinion states whether norms were violated and includes recommendations for remediation, training, or policy adjustments before it goes to the Executive Board.
process.appeal: Parties can request advice from LOWI within six weeks if they disagree with the institutional decision.

data_status.notes: Desk research update on institutional integrity pages (Nov 2025).
